Title: Log in with valid credentials
Preconditions: InvenTree web UI reachable at /web/login; a valid user account exists
Test Steps: 1) Navigate to /web/login 2) Enter username 3) Enter password 4) Click 'Log In'
Expected Result: 'Login successful' toast appears; user is redirected to the Dashboard (/web/home); the top-right user menu shows the logged-in username

Title: Log in with an incorrect password is rejected
Preconditions: A valid username exists
Test Steps: 1) Navigate to /web/login 2) Enter a valid username 3) Enter an incorrect password 4) Click 'Log In'
Expected Result: A 'Login failed (400)' error toast appears with message 'The username and/or password you specified are not correct.'; user remains on the login page

Title: Log in with blank username and password is blocked client-side
Preconditions: On the login page
Test Steps: 1) Leave Username and Password blank 2) Click 'Log In'
Expected Result: Both fields are marked required (red asterisk); form does not submit / no network request is made for the login attempt

Title: Log out returns the user to the login page
Preconditions: User is logged in
Test Steps: 1) Click the user menu (top-right, shows current username) 2) Click 'Logout'
Expected Result: 'Logged Out' / 'Successfully logged out' toast appears; user is redirected to /web/login; navigating back to any authenticated page redirects to login again

Title: Top navigation bar links to each core module
Preconditions: User is logged in
Test Steps: 1) Click 'Parts' 2) Click 'Stock' 3) Click 'Manufacturing' 4) Click 'Purchasing' 5) Click 'Sales'
Expected Result: Each click navigates to that module's landing page without a full page reload error; the clicked tab is visually highlighted as active

Title: Breadcrumb navigation returns to the parent Category
Preconditions: At least one Part Category exists
Test Steps: 1) Open a Part Category 2) Open a Part inside it 3) Click the Category's name in the breadcrumb trail
Expected Result: User is returned to the Part Category detail page, not the root Parts list

Title: Create a Part Category with only the required Name field
Preconditions: User logged in; on Parts > Part Categories
Test Steps: 1) Click '+' above the category table 2) Enter a unique Name 3) Leave all other fields blank 4) Click Submit
Expected Result: 'Item Created' success toast appears; the new category appears in the Part Categories table with the given name

Title: Category creation is rejected when Name is blank
Preconditions: 'New Part Category' modal is open
Test Steps: 1) Leave Name blank 2) Click Submit
Expected Result: A red 'Form Error' banner reads 'Errors exist for one or more form fields'; the Name field is outlined in red with inline text 'This field is required.'; no category is created

Title: View Category Details tab shows the created values
Preconditions: A Category exists
Test Steps: 1) Open the Category 2) Select 'Category Details' in the left-hand tab list
Expected Result: Name, Description, and other saved fields are displayed matching what was entered on creation

Title: Category detail page exposes Subcategories, Parts, Stock Items, Parameters, and Parameter Templates tabs
Preconditions: A Category exists
Test Steps: 1) Open the Category 2) Inspect the left-hand navigation list
Expected Result: Tabs 'Category Details', 'Subcategories', 'Parts', 'Stock Items', 'Parameters', and 'Parameter Templates' are all present and clickable

Title: Create a Part with only the required Name field
Preconditions: User logged in; inside a Part Category's 'Parts' tab
Test Steps: 1) Click '+' > 'Create Part' 2) Enter a unique Name (Category is pre-filled) 3) Click Submit
Expected Result: 'Item Created' toast appears; user is taken to the new Part's detail page; the status badge reads 'NO STOCK'

Title: Part creation is rejected when Name is blank
Preconditions: 'Add Part' modal is open
Test Steps: 1) Leave Name blank 2) Click Submit
Expected Result: Red 'Form Error' banner appears; Name field shows 'This field is required.'; no Part is created; modal remains open with other entered values retained

Title: Edit an existing Part's Name via the Part Actions menu
Preconditions: A Part exists
Test Steps: 1) Open the Part 2) Click the Part Actions icon (gear/cluster icon in the page header) 3) Click 'Edit' 4) Change Name 5) Click Submit
Expected Result: Modal closes; the Part Details page header and 'Name' field reflect the updated value immediately

Title: Part Actions menu offers Duplicate, Edit, and Delete
Preconditions: A Part exists
Test Steps: 1) Open the Part 2) Click the Part Actions icon
Expected Result: A menu opens listing 'Duplicate', 'Edit', and 'Delete'

Title: Delete is disabled for a Part that has stock or is active
Preconditions: A Part exists with active=true and/or at least one stock item
Test Steps: 1) Open the Part 2) Click the Part Actions icon 3) Inspect the 'Delete' menu item
Expected Result: 'Delete' is greyed out / disabled and cannot be clicked, consistent with the API blocking deletion of active/stocked Parts

Title: Duplicate creates a second Part pre-filled from the original
Preconditions: A Part exists
Test Steps: 1) Open the Part 2) Click Part Actions > 'Duplicate' 3) Inspect the pre-filled form 4) Submit with a new unique Name
Expected Result: A new, separate Part is created carrying over the original's other field values (description, category, etc.)

Title: Cancelling the Add Part form does not create a record
Preconditions: 'Add Part' modal is open with a Name entered
Test Steps: 1) Enter a Name 2) Click 'Cancel' instead of Submit 3) Refresh the Parts list
Expected Result: No new Part appears in the list; the cancelled name was never persisted

Title: Create a new Parameter Template inline while adding a Parameter
Preconditions: A Part exists; no matching Parameter Template exists yet
Test Steps: 1) Open the Part > 'Parameters' tab 2) Click '+' > 'Create Parameter' 3) Click the '+' beside the Template field 4) Enter a Template Name 5) Submit the template 6) Enter a Data value on the now-selected template 7) Submit the parameter
Expected Result: 'Item Created' toast appears after both the template and the parameter are saved; the Parameters table lists the new row with Name='Color' and Data='Red'

Title: Parameter Data field is required
Preconditions: 'Add Parameter' modal open with a Template already selected
Test Steps: 1) Leave Data blank 2) Click Submit
Expected Result: Form error is shown for the Data field; no parameter row is added

Title: Add a Stock Item to a Part
Preconditions: A Part exists with 'NO STOCK' status
Test Steps: 1) Open the Part > 'Stock' tab 2) Click the add-stock action 3) Accept the default Quantity (or set a value) 4) Click Submit
Expected Result: 'Stock item created' toast appears; user is taken to the new Stock Item's detail page; the Part's status badge changes from 'NO STOCK' to 'IN STOCK: <quantity>'

Title: Newly added stock appears in the Part's Stock tab table
Preconditions: A Stock Item was just added to a Part
Test Steps: 1) Return to the Part > 'Stock' tab
Expected Result: The Stock table lists the new stock item with the correct Stock quantity and Status='OK'

Title: Cross-functional flow: create a Part, add a Parameter, add Stock, and verify aggregation in the Category view
Preconditions: A Part Category exists
Test Steps: 1) Create a Part inside the Category (Name only) 2) Open the Part > 'Parameters' tab and add a Parameter (creating a Template if needed) 3) Open the Part > 'Stock' tab and add a Stock Item with Quantity=1 4) Navigate back to the parent Category's 'Parts' tab
Test Data: Part Name=<unique>, Parameter Template=Color, Data=Red, Stock Quantity=1
Expected Result: The Part's status badge shows 'IN STOCK: 1' on its own detail page; the Category's Parts table shows the same Part with a 'Total Stock' value of 1, confirming stock aggregation is reflected at the category level

Title: Search box filters the Parts table by name
Preconditions: At least 2 Parts exist with distinguishable names
Test Steps: 1) Open a Parts table (category or global Parts view) 2) Type a substring unique to one Part into the Search box
Expected Result: The table updates to show only Parts whose name contains the substring

Title: Category column in the Parts table links back to the Category
Preconditions: A Part is assigned to a Category
Test Steps: 1) Open the global Parts list 2) Click the Category name in that Part's row
Expected Result: User navigates to that Category's detail page
